findings.quote: Three nights. That's the rule, that's not me. Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday morning the meeting decides whether you stay.
findings.claim: Reads Owen's count as three nights in addition to the arrival night, which would give Ruth four nights before the fourth-morning decision.
findings.fix: Have the arrival night count as the first of the three.
